posts.body: I have been trying to get this bep-bep-bep sound effects when message pops up in rpgmaker MZ just like in MV but I have been struggling. I just got this pluggin called GALV_MessageSoundEffects and not going to lie it sounds even more dreadful. Could anybody help me? I am using the exact same audio file in MV and MZ so the audio isnt the problem. Its 0:00 seconds long since its so fast. I got two pluggings. the first one just plays it once the other one is just awful

posts.author: Eliaquim
posts.body:
Hi there!
You need to explain better what you did. I mean, show what you did.
Both plugin makers are good around here to have a dreadful or awful plugin. Maybe it is something to do with the configurations you made.
So try to show to us how did you setup the galv plugin and how did you setup the MPP_MessageSE. And also make sure that both plugins are also created for RPG Maker MZ.
Good luck
